packages/ui/src/foundations/debounce.ts.reason: The one shared debounce for specified pauses after the last input (autosave, search, live preview): the pause is elapsed time and no browser event says typing stopped; useDeferredValue defers rendering, not requests, so every keystroke would still send one

packages/ui/src/foundations/evry-life.ts.reason: The Evry bot animation loop: requestAnimationFrame paints each frame while a morph, spin, blink or gaze runs, and one timeout waits for the next scheduled blink while idle so idle bots cost no frames; CSS cannot drive per-frame path morphs or pointer gaze
Restarts the same Evry bot animation loop on the next frame after a mood, pointer or visibility change wakes an idle bot; it is the loop's entry point, not an ordering patch

packages/ui/src/foundations/minute-clock.reason: The one shared minute clock behind relative times and the 48-hour call window, replacing the two intervals the app had: the passing minute is the behavior and nothing else signals it; one interval for all subscribers, cleared with the last

packages/ui/src/foundations/observe.ts.reason: The one shared scroll observer for a node's position (active heading, reading progress): where the page itself scrolls (no scroll column), only the window's scroll event says the node moved. Added when the node attaches and removed when it detaches; no observer reports a continuous position

The viewport option re-measures the node when the window is resized, for layouts that depend on the viewport and not on the node's own box (which the ResizeObserver already covers). Added when the node attaches and removed when it detaches
